title: Chinta Aisi Dakini
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Chinta Aisi Dakini" where he says that the state of mind being anxious is like a fire in the ocean, neither smoke comes out of it nor is it visible to anyone.

title: Jin Khoja Tin
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Jin Khoja Tin" where he says if you try hard enough, then you will definitely find your way. One must never give up trying as only then he can find. S01 E33.

title: Shram Hi Hota Hai
desc: Javed Akhtar elucidates on Kabir's doha "Shram Hi Hota Hai'. He says hard work is very important & if you are patient enough, the world will reward you well & bless you with abundance. S01 E53.

title: Dosh Paraye
